prompt.importLogs:
Convert my LLM usage data into my cost calculator's JSON import format. Return ONLY the JSON, no explanations.

FORMAT 1 — daily logs (preferred): an ARRAY, one object per day:
[{"time": "2026-09-03", "hit": 55153280, "miss": 1078210, "output": 520153}]
- time: the day's date. hit: INPUT tokens served from cache (no split? hit 0, all to miss). miss: input tokens processed from scratch. output: generated tokens.

FORMAT 2 — direct total: one OBJECT with totals plus days covered:
{"hit": 900000000, "miss": 30000000, "output": 15000000, "days": 30}

Rules: integer token counts (1K=1000, 1M=1000000). Don't invent numbers (0 if missing, tell me in one line). Aggregate per day if multiple models. Ignore $/€, TOKENS only.

My data:
[PASTE your data here]
